title: La Carta de Durango, MEXI STORIES
comment: carta-durango (MEXI): despacho de una hacienda ganadera cerca de Durango. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.FAUSTO_ELIZONDO: Mexican cattle hacienda owner from Durango, 63 years old, light weathered skin, thick white hair combed back, a short white beard, piercing grey eyes, a tan suede jacket over a white shirt with a silver bolo tie, dark trousers, brown cowboy boots, his hands empty.
chars.INES_OCAMPO: Mexican woman, 29 years old, olive skin, long dark-brown hair in a thick braid over one shoulder, dark determined eyes, small gold stud earrings, a simple mustard-yellow long-sleeve blouse, a long brown skirt, brown flat shoes, her hands empty.
chars.JOAQUIN_ELIZONDO: Mexican man, 32 years old, tanned skin, short black hair, light stubble, kind eyes, an open faded denim western shirt over a grey t-shirt, jeans, brown cowboy boots, his hands empty.
chars.PILAR_SOTO: Mexican woman, longtime housekeeper of the hacienda, 60 years old, brown skin, short curly grey hair, reading glasses hanging on a chain, a navy-blue cardigan over a floral blouse, a long grey skirt, flat shoes, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_DESPACHODURANGO: Study of an old cattle hacienda near Durango in the afternoon: a heavy dark-wood desk with a small locked drawer, a green desk lamp, leather armchairs, a framed painting of a bull, wooden bookshelves, a tall window showing dry plains and wooden corrals, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
